description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain commercial Android and iOS applications. This role covers the full mobile app development lifecycle, from gathering business requirements and designing user interfaces to coding, testing, documentation, and release.
 Responsibilities
 Develop and maintain Android and iOS applications based on business requirements.
 Build mobile interfaces and integrate REST APIs, push notifications, and local data storage.
 Participate in technical design, coding, testing, and documentation.
 Manage app releases and updates through Google Play and the Apple App Store.
 Support enterprise iOS app signing, in-house distribution, MDM deployment, certificate renewal, and troubleshooting.
  
 
 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining commercial applications.
 3+ years of experience developing both Android and iOS applications using Java and Objective-C.
 Proficiency with Android Studio, Xcode, Git, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, app lifecycle management, and memory management.
 Experience publishing and updating apps through Google Play and the Apple App Store.
 Hands-on experience with the Apple Developer Enterprise Program, distribution certificates, provisioning profiles, entitlements, and MDM-based deployment.
 Ability to prepare technical documentation and work independently or with a team.
  
  
 Preferred Qualifications
 Ability to discuss technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders in both Korean and English. 
 Experience with Apple Business Manager and Custom Apps distribution.
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
